svg.text: A chat prompt becomes committed project files, published as one atomic revision
LOOP until the answer is complete · carried on or repaired when it is not
register the turn · 409 if one is running · reserve budget · 402 if spent
GET files + contents → ProjectBrief, once per turn
tool call: read_files · only when files were left out of the brief
SSE text · status · replace (checklist ticks off live)
save ChatMessage + ChatEvents · the outcome on its first event
usage settled per model call · UsageLog + UsageEvent
SSE done { outcome } → the browser adopts the saved turn
closing the browser only stops watching · every turn is saved, however it ends
